CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION company_checkout_allowance_private.guard_report_metadata()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
begin
 if current_user<>'postgres' and ((tg_op='INSERT' and (new.company_allowance_selections is not null or new.company_allowance_legacy_labels is not null))
 or (tg_op='UPDATE' and (new.company_allowance_selections is distinct from old.company_allowance_selections
  or new.company_allowance_legacy_labels is distinct from old.company_allowance_legacy_labels))) then
  raise exception 'server-validated company allowance selections required' using errcode='42501';end if;
 return new;
end $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION company_checkout_allowance_private.report_basis(rid uuid)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
 select jsonb_build_object('header',jsonb_build_object('company_id',r.company_id,'site_id',r.site_id,
  'route_assignment_id',r.route_assignment_id,'report_date',r.report_date,'work_description',r.work_description),
  'workers',(select coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('worker_id',w.worker_id,'overtime_hours',w.overtime_hours,
   'early_hours',w.early_hours,'night_hours',w.night_hours,'allowance_amount',w.allowance_amount,
   'allowance_label',w.allowance_label,'work_category',w.work_category,'company_allowance_selections',w.company_allowance_selections)
   order by w.worker_id),'[]'::jsonb) from public.daily_report_workers w where w.report_id=rid))
 from public.daily_reports r where r.id=rid
$function$
